info.title: Instatus Universal API
info.description: Instatus is an uptime monitoring, incident response, status page, and subscriber communication platform for managing service status, incidents, maintenances, components, subscribers, and monitoring workflows.

autoStart.description: Whether Instatus should automatically start the maintenance at the start time.

autoEnd.description: Whether Instatus should automatically end the maintenance at the end time.

notifyStart.description: Whether to notify subscribers when maintenance starts.

notifyEnd.description: Whether to notify subscribers when maintenance ends.

notifyEarly.description: Whether to notify subscribers before maintenance starts.
